title: Quant vous me ferez (Busnoys)
desc: Antoine Busnoys, Quant vous me ferez. 3 voices (Discantus, Tenor, Contra), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Bus3050); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
